systems.system: digital registry of humanitarian assistance beneficiaries

note: Humanitarian beneficiary registry of a disaster agency, not a social registry; the INAS database is named only as an interoperability target.

facts.fact: The World Bank PID says Additional Financing 1 supports the legal and technical establishment of the National Social Registry, built by consolidating the current database through data cleaning and collection and registering new beneficiaries.
